top.name: Sovereign Pillars
top.rules_text: Raise 3 indestructible Sovereign Pillars for the rest of the fight. Allies on them gain +2 to all stats. Adjacent enemies deal 2 less and end their turn Weakened.
top.glyph_text: While it stands here it has +{armor} armor and +{ally_damage} spell damage, and it gains {shield} shield once per round. Adjacent enemies deal 2 less and end their turn Weakened.

bottom.name: Puppeteer
bottom.rules_text: For 2 turns, at the start of each round, every enemy walks up to 2 tiles toward your nearest glyph. Glyphs it walks onto trigger.

changes.value: Permanently enchant 3 Sovereign Pillars: allies on them gain +3 to all stats, adjacent enemies deal 2 less and are Hexed. Indestructible.
